body:
## Context

A bundle-scoped T4 contribution gate (`contribcheck`) is **default-open before the publish artifacts exist**: at Check time, `commit-msg.txt` and `pr-description.md` have not been drafted yet, so the checker passes vacuously. The real audit happens at publish via `at_publish` re-gating (#339). This layering is by design and documented in the rendered `pdca.toml` comments.

## Problem

The Check gate matrix records that default-open outcome as a plain green **PASS**, indistinguishable from a substantive pass. The reviewer leaf, asked to independently reproduce every recorded green, cannot: the artifacts the gate names are not among its inputs (they don't exist yet). Result: **T4 lands in SUMMARY §6 NEEDS-HUMAN on every single cycle.**

Evidence from the pdca-pdca instance's 2026-08-01 Act review: all **9 of 9** frozen bundles (#311, #316, #331, #340, #341, #359, #368, #375, #376 cycles) carried a §6 item of the form *"T4 Contribution — commit-msg.txt / pr-description.md were not supplied, so the recorded green cannot be independently confirmed"*. Bundle issue_341's §10 named the cause directly: *"T4 contribcheck runs too early at Check (vacuous default-open pass before the publish artifacts exist) — reconsider when/how T4 is reported in the Check matrix."*

## Proposal

When a bundle-scoped T4 row runs at Check and its checker reports the default-open condition (artifacts absent), record the row as **DEFERRED (re-gated at publish)** — or similar — rather than PASS:

- the Check matrix stops asserting a green nobody can reproduce;
- reviewers stop escalating a by-design condition to §6;
- the publish-time hard gate (#339) remains the substantive T4 verdict, unchanged.

This likely needs a distinguishable exit/marker from `contribcheck` for the default-open path plus matrix rendering support in the gates runner.

## Origin

Filed from the pdca-pdca self-hosting instance's Act review (process/act-log.md, 2026-08-01) — recurring-signal routing, not a contribution cycle.
title: Check matrix reports a default-open T4 contribcheck as PASS — reviewers escalate the vacuous green every cycle
